verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the MCP feature page, which says Superhuman Mail can draft follow-up nudges and send each one when the recipient is most likely to open it. That is a deferred, product-timed send, but only within MCP-driven follow-up workflows, not a user-chosen send-later time. Nothing in the pack documents undo send. Missing for 10: user-selected schedule-send time in the mail client, any undo-send grace window, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
